At most four new terms per level-2 section (style.md §3). draw/culling is the home of five terms.

%%% pass draw/culling
## What the camera sees

The **camera** is the point the scene is seen from.

The **view cone** is what it sees.

The **bounding box** is a box around a mesh.

## What is left out

An **occluder** hides other meshes.

**Culling** leaves out what the camera cannot see.
